correctness.rationale: An explicit complete proof via rank-four integral root reflections, the subword characterization of all Bruhat intervals, the standard corrected KL recurrence, and exact integer maxima. A standalone exact checker generates 1152 group matrices, 48 roots, validates lengths by root inversion, constructs 396809 Bruhat-comparable pairs, evaluates all 396809 KL polynomials independently using left- and right-descent recursions, checks identical outputs, then reproduces all 217 KL=2 elements with profiles 178/33/6 and the 11 maximum/equality/eligible-count rows. Limits are one finite Weyl group and ordinary rational cohomology.

value.rationale: The KL=2 stratum is a canonical minimal non-rationally-smooth locus, and the degreewise failure of Poincaré duality is a natural geometric invariant. Exact maximization on all such exceptional type-F4 Schubert varieties, with a complete eleven-degree sharpness/equality spectrum and a three-degree sharpness threshold, resolves a motivated finite classification not supplied by the general inequalities or known total-defect tables. It is structurally meaningful despite being finite; it makes no claim beyond the scoped exceptional root system.
